_README: Ground truth for the OCR accuracy harness. Fields are what a human reads off each SPECIMEN document. All images are public government/EU specimens or Wikimedia samples with fake identities — NO real customer PII (see fixtures/README.md for sources + licenses). docNumber/expiryISO/country are scored by exact match; firstName/lastName by normalized edit distance (diacritics intentionally kept in truth so MRZ-ASCII output is penalized but not failed).
